question: Unlike other French settlements (like Pondicherry, Karaikal, Mahe, and Yanam) which merged with the Indian Union in 1954 via de facto transfer, how and when was Chandernagore officially integrated into India?
options: It was annexed by Indian military action in 1948 during Operation Polo
A plebiscite was held in June 1949 where the citizens voted overwhelmingly to join India, followed by de jure transfer in 1952 and formal merger with West Bengal in 1954
It was purchased by the Indian government from the French Fourth Republic in 1950
It remained a French territory until 1962, when the French Parliament ratified the treaty of cession for all enclaves
explanation: Chandernagore had a unique path to integration. In June 1949, a plebiscite was held in which 99% of the population voted for merger with India. The French government conceded, and de facto control was transferred in 1950. The de jure treaty of cession was signed in 1951 and ratified in 1952. In 1954, it was formally merged with the state of West Bengal.
